{{Top|leg}}

'''Cyber-mnemonic implants''' were [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] devices that were used to make [[GeNode]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] as obediently remorseless and unreadable as a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The mad [[Geneticist/Legends|genetic]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] and [[Clone Master/Legends|master cloner]] [[Zeta Magnus]] installed a cybernetic control band around the head of his [[Thyrsian]] [[Tark Squad|clone warriors]] to maintain his complete control over them. He also planned to install a more concealed variant of this technology in the clones of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi (clone)|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker (clone)|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Halagad Ventor (clone)|Halagad Ventor]].
